summary: On paper Dallas has the edge (Dallas' defense ranks 30th in explosive play rate, 9.2% allowed). Under center, Dak Prescott ranks 13th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Jacoby Brissett ranks 28th; x-factor: CeeDee Lamb gets 31% of Dallas' targets and 40% of its air yards, and Arizona's pass defense ranks 28th. The model favors Dallas at 76%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.5 pts) and starting QB (2.4 pts).
